name: uxcalibur
description: UXcalibur versioned skill and private developer-proof harness

scripts.verify: pnpm skill:copy && pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm proof:baseline
scripts.site:check: pnpm --dir sites/uxcalibur-dev check && pnpm --dir sites/uxcalibur-dev build
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify && pnpm package:check && pnpm site:check
scripts.deploy:site: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages deploy sites/uxcalibur-dev/build --project-name uxcalibur-dev --branch main
